## Objective
- Finish and validate the existing Portuguese-language football manager game as a complete, playable game.
- Improve its visual presentation while preserving existing mechanics.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.
- Save check screenshots as small JPEGs at a viewport no wider than 1280px; inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Preserve the existing game and improve its visual presentation rather than replacing its mechanics.

## Work State
### Completed
- Replaced `style.css` with responsive styling for the dashboard, squad, tactics pitch, transfer market, modals, and mobile navigation.
- Fixed training modal markup in `game.js`; the training focus options now render and the confirm action works.
- Added a data-URL favicon in `index.html` to avoid a missing favicon request.
- Validated squad display, training, tactics and persistence, signing a player, and simulating a match; match stats and history persisted after reload.
- Captured and inspected `/tmp/opencode/onze-home.jpg` at 1280×900.
- `node --check game.js` passed; browser console showed no errors after the favicon change.

### Active
- Finish validation of the match flow and navigation, capture/inspect a fresh screenshot if needed, and summarize the completed work.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue browser checks from the current persisted career; verify the post-match screen and navigation.
2. Run final syntax/status checks and inspect the latest ≤1280px JPEG screenshot.
3. Summarize changes, verification, and any reasonable assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `style.css`: Responsive visual redesign.
- `game.js`: Existing mechanics and training modal fix.
